reviewed_by: Codex native Ask Nebula popup review
reason: Native Browser Ask Nebula opens a DOM popup that the macOS native webview can cover. Select the 15 popup lifecycle component tests and the 8 catalogued desktop Browser interaction tests, including the native page capture journey updated to verify popup visibility, Hide, Show, Close, and native browser visibility.
